paper.title_en: Ground state solutions for the nonlinear Schrödinger-Bopp-Podolsky system with periodic potentials
paper.abstract_en: This paper investigates the existence and multiplicity of solutions to the following Schrödinger-Bopp-Podolsky system: $\begin{aligned} \left\{ \begin{array}{ll} -\Delta u+V(x) u+\phi u =f(x,u), & \text{ in } \mathbb {R}^3,\\ -\Delta \phi +a^2\Delta ^2\phi =4\pi u^2, & \text{ in } \mathbb {R}^3. \end{array}\right. \end{aligned}$Here, V(x) is a positive, continuous, and spatially periodic potential, while the nonlinearity f(x, u) exhibits superlinear subcritical growth at infinity. We establish the existence of ground state solutions by constructing a minimizing Cerami sequence via the diagonal method. Furthermore, under the assumption that f is odd, we demonstrate the existence of infinitely many geometrically distinct solutions using Krasnoselskii genus theory. These results extend and complement existing findings in the literature.
